exposure: Mode of delivery (trial of labor or planned CS)
cohort: 204 women with preexisting diabetes (118 with type 1 diabetes and 86 with type 2) with singleton pregnancies
finding: In women with preexisting diabetes, nulliparity, presence of a hypertensive disorder, previous CS and shorter maternal height were predictors of emergency CS in women with a planned trial of labor, whereas late pregnancy maternal Hba1c or fetal size estimated by ultrasound were not.
mod_finding: Nulliparity, presence of a hypertensive disorder, previous CS and shorter maternal height were predictors of emergency CS in women with a planned trial of labor, whereas this not was the case for late pregnancy maternal Hba1c or fetal size estimated by ultrasound.
